who: Doric is a dwarf smith who lives alone in a little hut north of Falador, by the Taverley gate, making pickaxes for Nurmof's shop in the Dwarven Mine. Courteous, proud of his craft and fond of his solitude, he wants clay, copper and iron to keep his anvils busy, and a friend who loves metal as much as he does.
notices: the pickaxe on your back, and who made it
metal: what your armour is made of and how well it's worked
rough manners, and anyone shouting at someone smaller
whether you look like you could mine iron
a friend who brought him his clay
values: his pickaxes, the best in Gielinor by his own account
his solitude and his little home
his friends in the Dwarven Mine
talksAbout: his pickaxes and Nurmof's order (char.doric.pickaxes, char.doric.nurmof, char.doric.steel_pickaxe)
his hut, the quiet, and the wheat out front (char.doric.hut, char.doric.wheat_field)

address: 'traveller' in his own voice ('Hello traveller, what brings you to my humble smithy?'), 'friend' for someone who helped him. The dwarf speech will swap in 'human' on shared lines; his own lines should stay with 'traveller'.
grammar: polite, complete sentences, a little formal ('Many thanks!', 'Not to worry, stick at it.')
sarcasm delivered as courtesy when insulted ('How nice to meet someone with such pleasant manners.')
plain craftsman's statements of fact about his work
cheerful encouragement ('Can't beat a bit of mining')
rhythm: Friendly and unhurried, one sentence and done, sometimes a second with a bit of encouragement; judgement of metal first.
canon: "Hello traveller, what brings you to my humble smithy?" (Transcript:Doric)
"I make pickaxes. I am the best maker of pickaxes in the whole of Gielinor." (Transcript:Doric)
"Do come again when you need to shout at someone smaller than you!" (Transcript:Doric)
"Good, the love of metal is a thing close to my heart." (Transcript:Doric)
"Can't beat a bit of mining - it's a useful skill." (Transcript:Doric's Quest)
